newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Q2 unemployment 20.94 pct vs 21.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain Q2 unemployment 20.94 pct vs 21.49 pct.

text.p: Spanish unemployment fell to a rate of 20.94 percent in the second quarter from 21.49 percent in the first quarter, the National Statistics Institute INE said on Wednesday.
The data are based on an INE survey of households, completed on a quarterly rolling basis.
INE said the jobless rate fell 5.98 percent from the same quarter a year ago.
In the second quarter, the jobless total stood at 3.36 million people, with the unemployment rate at 16.34 percent among men and 28.19 percent among women.
